title: Antiviral immunity via telomerase-like reverse transcription in bacteria
title_zh: 细菌中通过端粒样逆转录实现的抗病毒免疫
abstract: Abstract Defence-associated reverse transcriptases (DRTs) use diverse and distinctive mechanisms of cDNA synthesis to protect bacteria against viral infection 1 . However, the functions and mechanisms of many DRTs remain unknown 2 . Here we identify a new antiviral defence system, DRT10, that associates with a noncoding RNA (ncRNA) to catalyse processive, protein-primed synthesis of tandem-repeat DNA. Reverse transcription is templated by a defined ncRNA region with a characteristic sequence pattern and template boundary elements, both of which are conserved and essential for DNA repeat addition. Cryogenic electron microscopy reconstructions reveal an unanticipated 2:1 architecture, wherein two reverse transcriptase (RT) monomers bind opposite sides of a pseudo-symmetric ncRNA. Biochemical experiments further demonstrate that each RT monomer reverse transcribes the template encoded on its respective side of the ncRNA. However, only one generates long repetitive DNA, using a template bounded by two flanking stem–loop anchors. This mode of iterative, boundary-delimited cDNA synthesis exhibits direct parallels to the mechanism of telomeric repeat addition by eukaryotic telomerase. Phylogenetic analyses of RTs across domains of life place telomerase in a monophyletic clade with the DRT family, which suggests a common origin for their DNA polymerization activities. Together with earlier studies of DRT2, DRT3 and DRT9 (refs. 3–5 ), our findings identify a conserved mechanistic logic that underlies RNA-templated DNA repeat addition across diverse DRTs despite vastly different architectural solutions. Moreover, our results expand the repertoire of reverse-transcription-based strategies for antiviral immunity in bacteria.
abstract_zh: 摘要 防御相关逆转录酶（DRTs）利用多样且独特的cDNA合成机制保护细菌免受病毒感染1。然而，许多DRTs的功能和机制仍然未知2。在这里，我们鉴定出一种新的抗病毒防御系统DRT10，它与非编码RNA（ncRNA）相关联，以催化进程性的蛋白引导的串联重复DNA合成。逆转录由一个具有特征序列模式和模板边界元件的明确ncRNA区域模板引导，这两者均保守且对于DNA重复添加是必需的。冷冻电镜重建揭示了意想不到的2:1结构，其中两个逆转录酶（RT）单体结合在伪对称ncRNA的两侧。生化实验进一步表明，每个RT单体逆转录其ncRNA各自一侧所编码的模板。然而，只有单体能生成长重复DNA，使用由两个侧翼茎–环锚点界定的模板。这种边界界定的迭代cDNA合成方式与真核端粒酶进行端粒重复添加的机制存在直接的平行关系。跨生命域RT的系发学分析将端粒酶与DRT家族置于一个单系支系中，暗示其DNA聚合酶活性有共同起源。结合对DRT2、DRT3和DRT9的先前研究（参考文献3–5），我们的发现确定了一种保守的机制逻辑，该逻辑尽管存在截然不同的架构方案，却支撑着多种DRTs中RNA模板引导的DNA重复添加。此外，我们的结果扩展了细菌中基于逆转录的抗病毒免疫策略范围。
